text:
maria: @channel quick heads-up — need alignment on renewal windows + SLAs for private committed offers we launched with Nimbus HW. Planning joint announcement next quarter; want seller ops checklist ready.
alex: high-level ask: define renewal trigger, 30/60/90 day outreach windows, and SLA for quote turnaround (we were thinking 3 biz days).
dan: agree on 3 biz days for quotes; need legal ok for auto-renew opt-in in private offers. cc @jess
jess: legal fine with opt-in but require explicit T&Cs in PO. I'll draft clause.
sam_ops: ops note: sellers need a single template they can use in marketplaces (Azure/Google). can we standardize sku naming? :thinking_face: \nmaria: yes — unified SKU + offer id. also need a "grace top-up" policy if usage spikes in renewal month.
alex: suggested policy: 15% grace for 30 days, then charge or move to reserved commit. feedback?
dan: sounds reasonable. customers with HW bundles get 30% grace for first renewal year.
jess: we should flag finance for revenue recognition implications. @finance-bot please advise.
finance-bot: FYI revenue team: grace periods affect ARR recognition. Recommend syncing with RevOps before launch.
sam_ops: for seller enablement, propose playbook: 1) Outreach email templates 2) Renewal calculator spreadsheet 3) Marketplace private-offer step-by-step
maria: can one of you create the renewal calculator? inputs: current monthly usage, committed tier, overage rate, proposed discount band.
alex: I'll build a simple calc and share CSV template. will include examples for HW+software bundle.
partner-exec: partner asks for predictable commit ceilings and a runway to convert meter to commit. propose staging: 60/30/10 over 3 quarters with discount taper.
maria: interesting. need to ensure this doesn't break our marketplace SKU discounting logic.
dan: ops concern: staged commit needs gating in billing to ensure partial credits apply.
sam_ops: will build gating rules — need list of billing codes from finance.
jess: legal will prepare an annex for staged commit terms.
alex: timeline proposal: draft docs by EOD Thu, seller playbook by next Tue, partner comms ready by next Fri.
maria: assign owners: alex (calculator + seller playbook), sam_ops (billing gating + template), jess (legal annex), dan (ops validation), me (partner comms + announce cadence).
dan: test matrix: simulate 3 customer profiles (startup, scale, enterprise) and validate renewal flows.
alex: sharing skeleton now: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/renewal-calc-template
sam_ops: thumbs up :thumbsup:. I'll start gating work tomorrow.
jess: working on annex draft now; will ping reviewers.
partner-exec: can we schedule a 30m alignment on Thurs 10am PT? prefer quick sync before docs freeze.
maria: scheduled — invite sent. thanks team.
